extension.description: Kodi Stalker client for accessing on demand videos and channels from Stalker middleware with 4-line server support
extension.news: v1.9.5 (2025-12-26) - Multi-Server Support: Switch between 4 different servers (Line1, Line2, Line3, Line4) - Auto MAC Rotation: Automatically fetch MAC addresses from server sources - Server change detection with auto token reset - Enhanced support menu with server switching and token management - Performance settings for page limits and retries
